Watch: Keep a close eye on your stops for SOXL and SPAL. Also, watch for continued strength in chip names, potentially driven by the AI/crypto narrative.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing your leveraged losses to protect your margin, while staying alert for new opportunities in core tech.
plays: Trim or exit SOXL and SPAL. Their deep losses and leveraged nature are a significant risk to your margin.
